newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Iran oil reserves 90 bln barrels - minister.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil reserves 90 bln barrels - minister.

text.p: Iran on Sunday put its proven crude oil reserves at 90 billion barrels and natural gas reserves at 21 trillion cubic metres.

Iranian Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh announced the figures at a news conference in Kuwait, adding: "The resources are still large and abundant and show us that we can discover in the future more and more".
Nejad Hosseinian, Deputy Petroleum Minister of International Affairs, told a conference in Iran earlier this month that Iran's total gas reserves were 23 trillion cubic metres.

Iran is the world's second largest oil exporter after Saudi Arabia and controls the world's second largest natural gas reserve which is largely untapped. It has an OPEC quota of 3.6 million barrels of oil per day.
